name: Apptus Contract Management
description_en:
Apptus Contract Management is a product in the Contract management category. Its directory profile covers Specialty Contracts, Sell Side (Customers), Lifecycle Management, Government Contracts, Full Text Search, Digital Signature, Contract Templates, Completion Tracking.

Additional listed capabilities include Buy Side (Suppliers), Auto Extraction, Approval Workflow, Milestone Tracking, Contact Management, Document Management, Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (iOS). The listed organization sizes are Large Enterprises Medium Business. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Business Hours.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: track significant project checkpoints; store and organize people, organizations and their contact details; organize documents and control their access and revisions; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Apptus Contract Management 属于合同管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括专门类型合同、销售方合同（客户）、生命周期管理、政府合同、全文搜索、数字签名、合同模板、完成情况跟踪。

资料还列出采购方合同（供应商）、自动提取、审批工作流、里程碑跟踪、联系人管理、文档管理、版本控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为大型企业 中型企业。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 工作时间支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：跟踪项目中的重要检查节点；集中保存和整理联系人、组织及其联系方式；整理文档并管理访问权限与版本；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
